_comment: HISTORICAL v0.1 CONTRACT, corrected for drift 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02.
The v0.1 FEATURE list below is still the contract and all seven rows in it
now exist in source. (It was written 'all eight'; there are seven rows here
and six numbered features in SPEC_SHEET.md, and a reader reconciling the two
landed on a third number. The count is seven. Do not renumber the rows.)
The STACK block was rewritten because it named four dependencies the
build deliberately does not have (Hilt, Room, Concentus, minSdk 30) and three
versions that were never adopted (Kotlin 2.1.0, CameraX 1.3.4). A machine
reader trusting the old values would look for code that cannot exist; this file
is called machine truth, so it has to be true.
Toolchain truth is gradle/libs.versions.toml (ADR-004). Architecture truth is
AGENTS.md + blueprints/CURRENT_STATE.md. RULES.md wins all conflicts.

version.on_device_note: SOURCE is vc12 / 0.3.2 (the wakeup-path kill switch, 2026-10-02) and BOTH PHONES ARE STILL ON vc11 / 0.3.1 (child 10:17:56, parent 10:18:11, installed -r so pairing and the consent grant survived). They must stay on 11 until the operator builds vc12: 11 rings at full volume on a child's KILLED phone after the grown-up switched calling off, which is the defect vc12 fixes. on_device is deliberately NOT equal to source. INSTALLED IS NOT WITNESSED: no SPEC_SHEET section-2 feature has been exercised on hardware on any build after vc7, and no version of this app has ever demonstrably enforced a kill switch. The deployed firestore.rules is the 2026-10-01 set and is BEHIND the tree: its consent read cannot be proven for a query, so the app is inert on both phones until the operator deploys.

features_v01.note: NOT re-proven on any build after vc7, including the vc11 now installed on both phones. A vc7 proof is not a current-build proof.
NOT re-proven on any build after vc7.
walkie-talkie voice clips, ADR-016; NOT the Concentus Opus path below. NOT re-proven on any build after vc7.
DataStore, NOT the Room store below — ADR-018

features_v01.status: SHIPPED + INSTALLED ON BOTH PHONES (2026-10-02), NEVER WITNESSED
features_v01.note: vc11 fixes a real enforcement gap: vc10 presented 'Turn everything off' while calling, the walkie talkie (both directions) and photo/chat DOWNLOADS continued unaffected, and the parent's own grant sequence was unreadable so the button could not act. vc11 is installed and unverified -- an install is not a witness, and no version of this app has ever demonstrably enforced a kill switch.

spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.actual: call log is DataStore preferences; the message thread is pair-scoped Firestore
spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.why: ADR-018: no Room/KSP in the build, and a 100-row log of small records does not need a database. Recorded as unmet, not reinterpreted.

spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.actual: voice clips and chat live in the pair room in Firestore
spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.why: the same argument voice clips already won (ADR-016): a message the child was told was sent must survive an offline phone. The stricter wording is NOT met and is recorded as such.

spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.actual: pair-scoped Firestore signaling + an ICE relay for media
spec_requirements_deliberately_not_met.why: ADR-015 replaced the rendezvous relay; K8 device-proven on mobile data

stack.ui: single-Activity + Compose Navigation (androidx.navigation 2.8.4) + hand-written ViewModel factories — NO Hilt
stack.camera: CameraX 1.4.2 (video call only; no camera is used for photos)
stack.wakeup: Firebase Cloud Messaging + a foreground service, token-targeted (ADR-016)
stack.pairing: unbundled ML Kit barcode 18.3.1 + ZXing 3.5.3 fallback — the one named exception to RULES §1.7 (recorded in RULES §1.7a and CURRENT_STATE K9; no ADR exists for it: ADR-009 is the Phase-7 data-channel decision and does not mention ML Kit)
stack.local_storage: DataStore 1.1.1 + an in-memory peer store — NO Room, NO SQLCipher, NO KSP, NO OkHttp

ports._comment: STATUS per port. A port is 'ADAPTED' when its contract was met by new code, and 'SUPERSEDED' when a later ADR replaced the design outright.
ports.AudioFrameCipher AES-256-GCM per-frame: NOT APPLICABLE — WebRTC provides DTLS-SRTP; there is no raw frame path to encrypt
ports.SovereignImageEngine chunked photo: ADAPTED — PhotoTransfer chunk+verify meets the same contract, proven byte-identical on a host fixture
ports.RendezvousClient + relay main.go :8792/u: SUPERSEDED — pair-scoped Firestore + an ICE relay (ADR-015, ADR-005)
ports.RealTimeTransportRouter P1-LAN P2-SIM: SUPERSEDED — STUN/TURN covers both, K8 device-proven on mobile data

firebase.role: call signaling, consent certs, chat, photos, and a data-only ring/clip push
firebase.rooms: calls/{uidA_uidB} — the id IS the two UIDs, so rules authorize from the path alone. Fields: status, seq, callerUid, calleeUid, offer, answer, callerCandidates, calleeCandidates, renegotiating, negotiationRound, updatedAt. One level below the room: ptt/, chat/, photos/{photoId} + photos/{photoId}/chunks/{index}, consents/{granteeUid}, revocations/{revocationId}. Also users/{uid}.fcmToken (owner-only) and pairings/{uid} (get by id only, no list)
firebase.media: never via Firebase; DTLS-SRTP end to end
firebase.deployed: vc10 ruleset, RELEASED 2026-10-01 to calldad-508d7 — chat, photos (manifest + chunks), consents, revocations and the negotiationRound guards ARE live. Deployed-but-UNWITNESSED: no phone has run a single chat write, photo transfer, consent grant or ICE restart against them.

human device proof (never claimed by the agent lane)
